title: Embedding gather: choose optimal page size (real C++)
info: Real C++: sweeps a fixed fully-associative LRU TLB model (16 entries) over several candidate page sizes for the same scattered embedding-gather trace and picks the one with fewest misses, compiled by clang++.
the driver's candidates include an intentional tie between two huge page sizes -- the tie-break rule (prefer the smaller page size) is part of what's graded.
